lesson.title: Verify Customer Order Intent Before Refusing New Orders
lesson.when: A customer explicitly requests to place an order for specific or remaining cart items
lesson.do: Execute the required tools to quote and place the requested order based on the user's updated selection
lesson.otherwise: Express uncertainty about the cart state without falsely claiming no new order will be created
